citation: Whitehouse, G.A. and Aydin, K.Y. (2020). Assessing the sensitivity of three Alaska marine food webs to perturbations: an example of Ecosim simulations using Rpath. Ecological Modelling 429, 109074. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ecolmodel.2020.109074
